races.name: Racing To School Reaches 25 Years Apprentice Handicap

runners_data.name: Invitorio
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits the likely pace scenario but carries top weight and lacks a recent win

runners_data.name: Latin Five
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with strong course form including third in this race last year, drawn wide but suits the shape
runners_data.comment: On a good mark; close third in this race last year; may prove vulnerable from a wide stall
runners_data.spotlight: Has run well over C&D, including when a close third in this race 12 months ago, but the track doesn't always lend itself to his hold-up style; drawn widest and could prove vulnerable, for all he is attractively weighted.

runners_data.name: Soul Seeker
runners_data.note: Only natural leader will get uncontested lead but hasn't won since 2024 despite dropping in class
runners_data.comment: Had poor year in 2025; down in weights as a result but no great record after an absence
runners_data.spotlight: Regressed sharply in 2025, his first blank campaign since 2020; he has dropped a long way in the weights as a result and he now tackles his first 0-55 on grass; whether first time out is the time to catch him is a moot point too.

runners_data.name: Sir Benedict
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid recent form, well-placed tactically for the likely scenario

runners_data.name: Jamie's Choice
runners_data.note: Won twice on turf in 2024 and was second in this race last year after similar 204-day break
runners_data.comment: Struggled after finishing second in this race in 2025; 7lb lower this time around
runners_data.spotlight: Won two classified events over 5f on turf in 2024; she finished a close second in the corresponding race 12 months ago (after an identical 204-day absence) but that was her only bright spot last year; 7lb lower this time around and she can't be discounted.

runners_data.name: Running Cool
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who fades in finishes, concerning trait for a likely strong pace
runners_data.comment: Should be well handicapped but he has been disappointing so far in 2026
runners_data.spotlight: Good second at Wolverhampton on his stable debut last September; well short of that level in three runs this year, including when tried in cheekpieces 19 days ago; risky.

runners_data.name: Golden Prosperity
runners_data.note: Forward-going type with course-and-distance win, high on shortlist with recent form
runners_data.comment: C&D winner; returns to turf off a fair mark; well drawn and he is one to take seriously
runners_data.spotlight: Three of his four wins have come in classified company but the other was a C&D handicap; this mark in range judged on last season's best efforts and he is high on the list from a handy draw.

runners_data.name: Beneficiary
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse better on AW than turf based on 2025 form, trainer out of form
runners_data.comment: Good chance if converting AW form to turf but hasn't managed that in five attempts before
runners_data.spotlight: Three times a runner-up on AW this year; unplaced in five turf runs and he comes here with a point to prove.

runners_data.name: Tommytwohoots
runners_data.note: Prominent style with two seconds in this race previously, decent recent AW form
runners_data.comment: Twice second in the corresponding race; unraced on faster than good to soft
runners_data.spotlight: Finished second in this race in 2023 (soft) and 2024 (heavy); good second at Wolverhampton on his stable debut (6f) two weeks ago; well drawn back on turf but his 18 turf runs have seen him steer clear of anything faster than good to soft.

runners_data.name: Doralee
runners_data.note: Forward-going mare who may struggle to find winning form based on limited success rate
runners_data.comment: Only win came in classified company; sharper for last month's return; others appeal more
runners_data.spotlight: Gained her only win from 16 attempts in a 5f classified event at Redcar last August; shaped as though the run was needed on her AW return last month; others appeal more for win purposes.

runners_data.name: Baby Rover
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 190-day break but has course-winning form over 6f
runners_data.comment: Her one win and most of her best runs have come over 6f; best watched after 190 days off
runners_data.spotlight: Won a 6f handicap at Redcar last summer; runner-up twice afterwards but she has been absent since a low-key run at Newcastle 190 days ago; best form has come at 6f.

runners_data.name: Siviez
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits but dropping to 5f for first time with weak recent form over longer trips
runners_data.comment: Poor form over 7f and 1m; drops in trip with a point to prove
runners_data.spotlight: Five runs, all over further, and she has run to just a modest level; drops to 5f with a point to prove.

races.paceDynamic: Soul Seeker is the only confirmed front-runner and will dictate proceedings from the stalls, likely setting a sustainable tempo without pressure from pace rivals. The prominent runners Golden Prosperity, Running Cool, Tommytwohoots and Doralee will track behind but none are natural speed horses who'll press early. With a long run-in at Catterick's 5f course and most of the field preferring to be held up, the pace will likely be honest but not frantic. This shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish with late runs, as they'll have plenty of pace to aim at and a strong gallop to close into.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Soul Seeker sets reasonable fractions and the prominent horses don't quicken dramatically
scenarios.body: The sustained pace allows the large contingent of hold-up horses to unleash finishing kicks, with Latin Five and Sir Benedict having proven course form to call upon. Jamie's Choice and Baby Rover can also benefit from their patient styles despite lengthy absences.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent horses gets first run on the field while Soul Seeker weakens
scenarios.body: Golden Prosperity or Tommytwohoots could capitalise on their forward positions, with both having recent course experience and the tactical speed to quicken. Their proximity to the pace gives them the jump on the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Soul Seeker Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If the veteran front-runner finds his best form after dropping to his lowest mark
scenarios.body: His uncontested lead could prove decisive if he rediscovers form, particularly as he drops into 0-55 company for the first time. The honest gallop he sets may not be fast enough to stop his kick.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Soul Seeker goes off too fast or the prominent horses fail to track properly
scenarios.body: A messy early pace could set up a blanket finish where any horse with a turn of foot can win. This chaotic scenario opens the door for the most unexposed or well-handicapped runners.

watchPoints.text: Soul Seeker's early fractions will determine if hold-up horses get the strong pace they need to be effective
Latin Five drawn in stall 12 could struggle to get competitive position from the wide draw despite his hold-up style suiting
Running Cool and Siviez both show fading tendencies which could be exposed in a strongly-run 5f contest
Jamie's Choice returning after exactly 204 days like her second-place effort in this race last year
Golden Prosperity wearing cheekpieces for the first time could find extra improvement to complement his forward style

races.name: Download The Raceday Ready App Handicap

runners_data.name: Dabbling
runners_data.note: Front-running style returning from 211-day break against stronger opposition than previously faced
runners_data.comment: 2-1 for handicap debut but finished last of nine and was found to have bled; off since
runners_data.spotlight: On the back of quite promising efforts on her first three starts she was backed into 2-1 favouritism for her Carlisle handicap debut in September but finished last of nine and was subsequently found to have bled; off since; it'll be interesting to see whether her supporters are prepared to give her another chance.

runners_data.name: Rotokura Belle
runners_data.note: Prominent runner switching from all-weather back to turf where she previously won at Southwell
runners_data.comment: Cosy winner at Southwell last autumn but below that level in three subsequent AW starts
runners_data.spotlight: Cosy winner over 5f at Southwell last September but hasn't come come close to reproducing that in three subsequent AW starts; it remains to be seen whether a return to turf sparks a revival.

runners_data.name: O Fortuna
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making handicap debut for Tim Easterby after 212-day absence, half-brother to smart sprinter
runners_data.comment: Potential improver in handicaps for yard with good recent record in this; interesting
runners_data.spotlight: No more than hinted at ability in three outings last year but this half-brother to the smart sprinter Adresita rates a potential improver now moving into handicap company for a yard which has won the last two runnings of this race; has been gelded; interesting, particularly if backed.

runners_data.name: Regal Dream
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who was backed favorite on handicap debut despite finishing fourth, suggesting ability
runners_data.comment: Only fourth on nursery debut in October but was 13-8 favourite; first run since
runners_data.spotlight: Could only manage fourth of eight on her 5f Redcar handicap debut (good) in October but the fact she went off the 13-8 favourite suggests better was anticipated; remains unexposed and it'll be interesting to see if there's money for her again back from six months off.

runners_data.name: Brave Traveller
runners_data.note: Front runner who edged out Liverpool Star last time and strips fitter after recent reappearance run
runners_data.comment: 6f Newcastle win in December; possibly just needed recent reappearance there; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Edged out Liverpool Star to win a 6f Newcastle handicap in December; faded into fifth on his reappearance there in March but is entitled to strip fitter for the outing; showed promise on turf at the start of his career; respected.

runners_data.name: Liverpool Star
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who has strong course form and was only narrowly beaten by Brave Traveller previously
runners_data.comment: In fair form on AW ahead of this return to turf; ought to be thereabouts
runners_data.spotlight: Edged out by Brave Traveller at Newcastle (6f) off this mark in December and respectable efforts in three subsequent AW outings; should be competitive back on turf.

runners_data.name: Empress Olivia
runners_data.note: Prominent runner dropping back to optimum 5f trip after struggling over longer distances recently
runners_data.comment: 6f turf maiden winner but fourth is the best she managed in three handicaps last year
runners_data.spotlight: Won Ripon maiden (6f, good) last summer; respectable efforts in her first two handicaps (both 6f turf) but well held over 7f on AW final start; drops back to the minimum trip on her return from five months off; others are more obvious.

runners_data.name: Moretons
runners_data.note: Prominent runner switching trainers to family operation, best form came over this 5f distance
runners_data.comment: Close second at Wolverhampton in October but well beaten since, including yard debut
runners_data.spotlight: Best effort for George Scott when beaten a neck in Wolverhampton handicap (5f, AW) in October but hasn't come close to backing it up in three outings since, including yard debut 34 days ago; plenty to prove for now.

runners_data.name: Jack Rabbit Slims
runners_data.note: Front runner returning from 196-day break with inconsistent handicap record but yard in form
runners_data.comment: Odd bit of promise last year but well held in both handicaps; been off for 196 days
runners_data.spotlight: Showed the odd bit of promise last year but finished down the field in his two handicaps; back from six months off with his yard in reasonable form.

runners_data.name: Contorno
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in excellent recent form with convincing Newcastle win showing clear improvement
runners_data.comment: 2-3 in AW handicaps; edged out a next-time-out winner latest so 2lb nudge may not stop him
runners_data.spotlight: Justified strong market support on his 5f Newcastle handicap debut in January; finished behind the reopposing Liverpool Star at Southwell next time but resumed his progression when landing another 5f Newcastle handicap last month; edged out a next-time-out winner on that occasion so should still be feasibly treated after a 2lb nudge.

races.paceDynamic: Dabbling, Brave Traveller and Jack Rabbit Slims will ensure a fierce early gallop over this sharp 5f trip, with four more runners (Rotokura Belle, Regal Dream, Empress Olivia, Moretons) wanting prominent positions creating serious congestion. The pace will be genuinely strong throughout with stamina at a premium in the final furlong. This setup heavily favors the hold-up horses O Fortuna and Liverpool Star who can avoid the early melee and finish fastest when others tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the front runners go too hard early and create a fierce gallop
scenarios.body: The strong pace will set up perfectly for Liverpool Star and O Fortuna to come from the back with late runs. The prominent runners will have used too much energy fighting for position in the early stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can secure an ideal pitch without over-racing
scenarios.body: Regal Dream or Empress Olivia could get the perfect trip just behind the leaders and have enough left to hold off the closers. Their class edges become decisive when getting the right setup.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the pace surprisingly moderates with the leaders going steady early
scenarios.body: Brave Traveller could dictate throughout and prove too strong, especially with his recent Newcastle win giving him confidence. His stamina would stretch the field if allowed comfortable fractions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the three confirmed front runners all miss the break or go extremely slowly
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where any running style can win depending on position and luck in running. Contorno's recent form could prove decisive in a messy finish.

watchPoints.text: Brave Traveller and Dabbling could clash for the early lead creating a suicidal pace that sets up the race for closers
Traffic problems likely in the 2-3 furlong marker as four prominent runners fight for limited space behind the leaders
O Fortuna making his handicap debut after a long break could either improve significantly or need the run
Liverpool Star has the best course experience and tactical setup if the pace unfolds as expected
Regal Dream was strongly backed on handicap debut suggesting connections expect significant improvement

races.name: Visit racingtv.com Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Forest Phoenix
runners_data.note: Well-bred Lope De Vega gelding making debut for Tim Easterby, though stable in poor form with 0 from 18 in last 14 days
runners_data.comment: Bred to have future but Red Spells Danger yard first string unless betting says otherwise
runners_data.spotlight: 50,000gns gelded son of Lope De Vega and the second foal of a 1m Listed winner; bred to have a future but Red Spells Danger has to be considered the stable's first string unless the betting strongly hints otherwise.

runners_data.name: Talking In Kode
runners_data.note: Another newcomer but from Edward Bethell yard in better form, unknown style but breeding suggests middle-distance potential

runners_data.name: North Force
runners_data.note: Showed promise when placed over 6f and 7f last season, prominent style suits if pace is steady, 163 days off concerning
runners_data.comment: Well-bred colt who shaped well when placed over 6f/7f last year; definitely more to come
runners_data.spotlight: Frankel colt out of a Group 2 winner; promise when placed over 6f at Doncaster (good) and 7f at Redcar (good to soft) last year; shaped particularly well at the latter venue given he lost plenty of ground at the start when his blindfold appeared to get stuck; definitely more to come.

runners_data.name: Jeddaal
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner with fair 7f form, should get uncontested lead but disappointed when odds-on last time at 6f
runners_data.comment: Fair form over 7f last year and likely to be on the premises again on reappearance
runners_data.spotlight: Fair form at around 7f on going ranging from good to firm to good to soft last year; below par when turned over at short odds over 6f on soft final start; reappears having been gelded; sure to be thereabouts if recapturing anywhere near the best of his 2yo form.

runners_data.name: Finlaggan
runners_data.note: French recruit who faded badly at Southwell 13 days ago, likely needs further than 7f based on running style
runners_data.comment: No short-term promise for shrewd new connections on AW last month
runners_data.spotlight: French recruit who didn't offer immediate promise for shrewd new connections at Southwell (1m; 16-1) 13 days ago.

runners_data.name: Red Spells Danger
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up type whose Ayr form has worked out well, needs strong pace to be effective from rear
runners_data.comment: Promise on all four 7f starts as a juvenile and capable of winning races in 2026
runners_data.spotlight: Promise in defeat on all four 7f starts last year; the form of his penultimate third in a soft-ground novice at Ayr has worked out really well and he's capable of winning races in 2026.

runners_data.name: Hatamoto
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who hasn't raced for 257 days, two moderate efforts over 6f suggest 7f might suit better

runners_data.name: The Floors Munky
runners_data.note: Prominent runner but well held in both starts, 18-day gap since latest disappointing Southwell effort
runners_data.comment: Well held on both starts and a likely outsider
runners_data.spotlight: Well held on both starts seven months apart (trained by Iain Jardine on debut); likely outsider.

runners_data.name: Decem Starr
runners_data.note: Showed improvement when second at Leicester, hold-up style needs pace collapse after 163-day absence
runners_data.comment: Fair form at 2, notably 7f Leicester second; gelded ahead of return; thereabouts
runners_data.spotlight: Left debut effort behind to finish second at Leicester (7f, good) last September; respectable fifth in another 7f novice at Redcar (good to soft) later in the autumn; gelded ahead of reappearance; ought to be thereabouts.

runners_data.name: Hansteen
runners_data.note: Well held in heavy ground twice, needs significant improvement and likely better suited to handicaps
runners_data.comment: Well held in two outings in the mud last autumn and likely more one for handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Well held in two outings in the mud last autumn and likely to be more one for handicaps after this.

runners_data.name: Keep It Classic
runners_data.note: Fading finisher who needs strong pace, gelded since last run but three poor 7f efforts suggest limited ability
runners_data.comment: Type to do better for leading yard but possibly not until handicapping
runners_data.spotlight: Useful pedigree but finished down the field in three 7f outings towards the end of 2025; gelded ahead of reappearance; will likely have bigger performances in him this year but possibly not until handicapping.

races.paceDynamic: Jeddaal is the confirmed front-runner and will likely get an uncontested lead with North Force and The Floors Munky settling prominently behind. The early pace should be sustainable rather than fierce, allowing Jeddaal to dictate terms through steady fractions. Multiple hold-up horses including Red Spells Danger, Decem Starr, and the newcomers will need the pace to collapse late. This controlled tempo strongly favours either the uncontested leader or horses that can travel prominently and kick, rather than pure hold-up types who need a stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Jeddaal gets soft fractions and isn't pressured early
scenarios.body: The Ed Walker gelding can build an unassailable lead and maintain his gallop to the line. His front-running style is perfectly suited to exploit a moderate pace with multiple hold-up horses behind him.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Travellers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is steady but North Force or newcomers can quicken
scenarios.body: Horses settling in the first three can position perfectly to strike when the leaders tire. The Frankel colt North Force showed promise over this trip and can benefit from tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Types Benefit
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is stronger than expected or Jeddaal gets pressured
scenarios.body: Red Spells Danger and Decem Starr can capitalize on a collapsed pace scenario. Their proven form at this distance gives them the edge over other hold-up types if the race sets up for closers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Newcomer Impact
scenarios.trigger: If Forest Phoenix or Talking In Kode show unexposed ability
scenarios.body: The well-bred newcomers from strong yards could exploit their unknown quantities status. Their breeding suggests they have more natural ability than exposed runners, though debut uncertainty remains.

watchPoints.text: Jeddaal could get away with murder if allowed uncontested fractions by a field packed with hold-up horses
North Force needs to overcome 163-day layoff but his Frankel breeding and previous 7f form make him interesting if sharp
Forest Phoenix and Talking In Kode are complete unknowns but their breeding suggests more natural ability than several exposed runners
Red Spells Danger's hold-up style is vulnerable if Jeddaal gets easy fractions, needs someone to pressure the leader early
Tim Easterby's poor recent form (0 from 18) is concerning for both Forest Phoenix and Red Spells Danger

races.name: Bet At Racing TV Handicap

runners_data.name: Dr Rio
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who hasn't raced for 203 days and has only won at Beverley, making this return at Catterick a significant concern.
runners_data.comment: Beverley specialist; now ten and lacks a recent run; hasn't shone here previously
runners_data.spotlight: All six of his wins in Britain, and all ten of his outings last season, have come at Beverley; won over 7.4f/1m4f last summer but this 10yo lacks a recent outing and hasn't really shone on his three previous visits here.

runners_data.name: Farandaway
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse finally off the mark last time but faces a big step up in class from maiden company to handicap level.
runners_data.comment: In good form over 5f/6f on AW and in the mix if seeing out this new trip
runners_data.spotlight: Running well in defeat in 5f/6f handicaps on AW prior to getting off the mark at the 17th attempt in Newcastle maiden (6f, AW) three weeks ago; positive performances on all three previous visits here; untested at 7f but it's possible the trip will be within range; in the mix if seeing it out.

runners_data.name: Way To Dubai
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who struggles with consistency but won over 7f in January, though slow starts have been costly recently.
runners_data.comment: Poor strike-rate in Britain but has managed a win this year and might not be far away
runners_data.spotlight: He's won just once since making his British debut in October 2023; however, that came this January (7f, AW) and a slow start proved costly when back at 6f at Southwell last Thursday; effective on turf and might not be far away now back up in trip.

runners_data.name: Vince Le Prince
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from 162-day break but has shown course form with a second here last October.
runners_data.comment: 0-16 last year but runner-up four times and he goes well fresh; could be bang there
runners_data.spotlight: 0-16 last year but runner-up four times, including over C&D last October when last seen; he's run well on his reappearance in each of the last two seasons and this three-time C&D winner could be bang there.

runners_data.name: Yafaarr
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who showed good form for new connections last autumn, though returning after 135 days off.
runners_data.comment: In fine form for new yard last autumn; leading player if continuing good work on return
runners_data.spotlight: In fine form for new yard last autumn, predominantly on AW but also when close third at Redcar (7f, good); he can play a leading role if continuing the good work on this return to action.

runners_data.name: Hostility
runners_data.note: Prominent runner on a dangerous low mark despite being a 13-race maiden, dropping significantly in the weights.
runners_data.comment: Below best towards end of last year and 0-13, but he's dropped to a dangerous mark
runners_data.spotlight: 13-race maiden who wasn't at his best towards the end of last year; however, he's dropped to a dangerous mark and it will be no surprise if he's in the shake-up on this reappearance, for which he wears a first-time visor.

runners_data.name: Tarlac
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who may have needed his recent comeback run and is 6lb lower than when winning last May.
runners_data.comment: 6lb below last May's last winning mark but there was no return to form on recent comeback
runners_data.spotlight: He's 6lb lower than when winning at Ripon (6f, good to soft) last May and he may have needed his recent comeback run at Newcastle; however, he was also below his best on his final few starts last term and 6f may suit best.

runners_data.name: Highfield Sunshine
runners_data.note: Prominent runner trying first-time hood after failing to fire in final two starts wearing blinkers then cheekpieces.
runners_data.comment: 12-race maiden but on a handy mark on last season's best form, including over C&D
runners_data.spotlight: Below best at the end of last season and she's 0-12; wears a first-time hood for this return, having worn blinkers then cheekpieces on final two runs last term; on a handy mark on last season's best efforts (including over C&D) and she's not discounted.

runners_data.name: Coconut Bay
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who lost form last autumn but won four times in 2023 including twice over course and distance.
runners_data.comment: She lost her form last autumn but a break may have helped; two C&D wins last summer
runners_data.spotlight: She lost her form last autumn but won four times during a busy 2025, two of them over C&D (good/good to firm), and a break may have helped; she's 3lb below her last winning mark and could have a big say.

runners_data.name: Roundhay Park
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner whose recent wins have come over 6f, making this step up to 7f a potential stamina concern.
runners_data.comment: Won at Ripon last July when 2lb lower; 6f seems to be this 11yo's optimum trip nowadays
runners_data.spotlight: Course winner who scored at Ripon (6f, soft) last July and is just 2lb higher on this reappearance outing; however, 6f has been this 11yo's optimum trip in recent seasons, and this is his first run since October.

runners_data.name: Evocative Spark
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who prefers turf to all-weather and won over course and distance on soft ground last autumn.
runners_data.comment: Won in good style over C&D last October and he's on the shortlist now back here
runners_data.spotlight: Down the field at Southwell (1m, AW) in February on sole run this year but he's just 1-22 on AW as opposed to 5-31 on turf; won in good style over C&D (soft) last October and, while slow ground would boost confidence in his claims, he may be okay on good going; on the shortlist now back here.

runners_data.name: Crocodile Power
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner whose four course wins have all come over 6f, though he has won here on good ground before.
runners_data.comment: His last four wins have come here, but over 6f, and soft ground appears to be preferable
runners_data.spotlight: His last four wins have come over 6f here; can't be ruled out given his record here and one of those wins came on good ground, but soft going appears to bring out the best in him and 6f looks to be his optimum trip; races for the first-time since December.

runners_data.name: Precious Spartan
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse stepping back down in trip after winning three times at 1m for current connections.
runners_data.comment: Progressive after joining this yard last May and he's one to consider on his reappearance
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive after joining this yard last May, winning three times at Ripon (1m, good) and posting a close third at Ayr (1m, soft) in September when last seen; the drop back to 7f might not be ideal on his reappearance but he's one to consider nevertheless.

runners_data.name: Wadacre Maestro
runners_data.note: The sole front-runner returning after 172 days but has course-and-distance winning form and faces no early pace pressure.
runners_data.comment: Inconsistent last year but won in August and remains lightly raced; could be a contender
runners_data.spotlight: Inconsistent last year but won at Musselburgh (7f, good) in August on his third handicap start and wasn't beaten far in fifth at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) when last seen; remains lightly raced and could be a contender.

races.paceDynamic: Wadacre Maestro is the sole confirmed front-runner in this 14-runner field, giving him a tactical advantage to dictate terms without early pressure. The prominent runners like Vince Le Prince, Hostility, Tarlac and Highfield Sunshine will sit just behind, but none are aggressive enough to challenge Wadacre Maestro's early lead. With most of the field showing hold-up tendencies including Dr Rio, Farandaway, Way To Dubai and Yafaarr, this sets up a pace scenario where the leaders get an easy time of it before the back-markers try to close late. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can secure good positions without using energy, while the large contingent of hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground from the back in a 7f handicap.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Wadacre Maestro gets an easy lead without pressure from the prominent runners.
scenarios.body: He dictates comfortable fractions and has enough left to repel late challenges, with other forward-positioned horses filling the places. The hold-up brigade struggles to make sufficient inroads from the rear in this sprint-middle distance.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Cooker
scenarios.trigger: If Vince Le Prince, Hostility and Tarlac all press forward to challenge Wadacre Maestro early.
scenarios.body: The pace quickens significantly as multiple horses vie for forward positions, setting up the race for a strong closer. Hold-up horses like Yafaarr and Farandaway benefit from the stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners sit too far back and allow Wadacre Maestro to dictate pedestrian fractions.
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too slow for the hold-up horses to be effective, but also allows Wadacre Maestro to save energy for a sustained kick. Mid-division horses with tactical speed benefit most from the positioning.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Surge Upset
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a tactical affair throughout.
scenarios.body: Despite the lack of early pace, one of the classy hold-up horses produces an exceptional turn of foot to overcome the positioning disadvantage. This requires everything to fall perfectly for the back-markers.

watchPoints.text: Wadacre Maestro must jump alertly and establish his lead early - any sluggish start leaves him without his key tactical advantage.
Monitor whether Vince Le Prince and Hostility press forward aggressively early, as this could set up the race for closers despite their long absences.
Watch for Farandaway's positioning from the rear as his recent maiden win may not translate to handicap class despite the confidence boost.
Precious Spartan drops back in trip after winning over 1m - observe if he can show the same turn of foot over this shorter distance.
Check Tarlac's early pace positioning as he may have needed his recent comeback run and could improve significantly for the outing.

races.paceDynamic: V Twelve will lead unchallenged through steady fractions, with Ebony Maw, Wheres The Crumpet, Nakatomi and Free Pic all wanting prominent positions creating congestion behind the leader. The genuine pace will come from this bunched group rather than pressure on V Twelve, setting up a tactical affair where positioning matters more than pure speed. With four horses fighting for the same prominent real estate and the rest held up, this creates a perfect storm for the hold-up horses who can avoid the traffic and find clear running late. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up merchants who can pick their way through and time their challenge.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet get in each other's way turning for home...
scenarios.body: The pace setters compromise each other while V Twelve's soft lead leaves him vulnerable to a well-timed challenge. Stellarmasterpiece and Kitsune Power can exploit their hold-up styles to find the clearest passage and strongest finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Leader
scenarios.trigger: If V Twelve gets completely uncontested fractions and the field comes too late...
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage while the prominent horses neutralise each other and the hold-up brigade leave it too late. V Twelve's fresh return and proven stamina at the trip sees him hold on despite the low weight behind.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Breaks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can secure the ideal position without traffic...
scenarios.body: Either Wheres The Crumpet or Free Pic manages to track V Twelve without getting caught in the squeeze, inheriting the lead smoothly and having enough in reserve. Their tactical speed advantage over the hold-up horses proves decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Meltdown
scenarios.trigger: If V Twelve stops and the prominent group implodes early...
scenarios.body: The race becomes a complete tactical mess with no clear pace narrative, turning into a sprint finish where recent form and fitness matter most. Tupero's February win and It's Only Fun's recent Doncaster effort give them the edge in a blanket finish.

watchPoints.text: Watch for traffic problems 2-3 furlongs out as Ebony Maw, Wheres The Crumpet, Nakatomi and Free Pic converge behind V Twelve
Monitor V Twelve's jumping off - if he misses the break the race shape completely changes with no clear leader
Check if Stellarmasterpiece shows early sharpness despite 211-day absence, as she's the most proven course performer
Observe Tupero's positioning early as his hold-up style and recent fitness could be crucial in a tactical finish
Watch for Kitsune Power making his move wide in the straight to avoid the anticipated prominent traffic jam

races.paceDynamic: Roland Garros is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the bell, likely setting a manageable gallop without pressure from the field of hold-up horses behind. The lack of pace pressure means Roland Garros can control splits and save energy for the finish, while the eight hold-up horses will be bunched together tracking the leader through modest fractions. This tactical scenario strongly favours front runners and prominent racers, as Roland Garros gets an uncontested lead while the hold-up brigade face a traffic-laden finish from similar positions. The pace shape definitively suits early pace and forward positioning.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Roland Garros maintains his controlled gallop without serious challenge
scenarios.body: The front runner dictates ideal fractions and has plenty left for the finish while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground from their bunched positions. Roland Garros exploits the tactical advantage of an uncontested lead over this staying trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and bunches the field completely
scenarios.body: The slow tempo allows the best handicapped hold-up horses to unleash devastating finishes from the pack, with class and form overcoming the tactical disadvantage. Superior ability trumps pace positioning in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Roland Garros sets unsustainably fast fractions trying to shake off the field
scenarios.body: The leader pays for overexertion in the final furlong, allowing the closest trackers with tactical speed to pounce late. Those positioned just off the pace benefit from both the setup and avoiding traffic.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Outsider Shock
scenarios.trigger: If the form horses all underperform due to fitness or ground concerns
scenarios.body: A value runner with hidden improvement or better conditions preferences capitalizes on market failures. The pace setup becomes secondary to individual horse improvement.

watchPoints.text: Roland Garros must be monitored for early pace - if he goes too fast trying to burn off the field, he'll set up the race for closers
Gastronomy's breathing after 181 days off following wind surgery - any respiratory distress will end his chances quickly
Hickton showing any signs of bleeding issues given his alarming reappearance when he bled at Southwell
The bunching of hold-up horses in the back half - traffic problems will be decisive in determining which ones get clear runs
Ground conditions staying consistent as Good - any softening would particularly help Naturalia and Hickton's prospects

races.paceDynamic: Valley Ofthe Kings will make the early running with Kats Bob and Sir Garfield likely to press forward, creating a moderate pace over 6f at Catterick. The prominent runners Aberama Gold and Miraculous should track the leaders, while the hold-up horses Trilby, Francisco's Piece, The Good Biscuit and Secret Guest will need the pace to collapse. With only one confirmed front-runner and several prominent types, this sets up as a sustained gallop rather than a sprint finish. This pace scenario strongly favours the prominent runners who can track the pace and kick, rather than the hold-up horses who may struggle to get into contention from the back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Valley Ofthe Kings sets a steady tempo without being harassed early
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get an ideal sit behind the pace-setter and have enough left to outkick the closers in the final furlong. Aberama Gold and Miraculous are perfectly positioned to exploit this tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Kats Bob and Sir Garfield press Valley Ofthe Kings into a faster pace than ideal
scenarios.body: The early leaders compound and the hold-up horses get their chance as the pace falls apart in the final 2f. The Good Biscuit and Trilby benefit most from this scenario given their proven ability to finish strongly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Valley Ofthe Kings gets an uncontested lead and dictates throughout
scenarios.body: The pace-setter builds an unassailable advantage and holds on grimly as the field struggles to close the gap. Kats Bob could also benefit if he can get closer to the pace than expected.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Messy Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes stop-start with no clear tempo early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair with horses getting shuffled back and needing luck in running. Any horse with tactical speed could benefit from the resulting scramble in the final 2f.

watchPoints.text: Valley Ofthe Kings must handle the sustained gallop as the only confirmed leader - if he stops quickly the hold-up horses get their chance
Miraculous and Francisco's Piece both returning from lengthy breaks exceeding 150 days without recent fitness work
The Good Biscuit showed best form on soft ground last year, needs to prove effectiveness on this good surface
Kats Bob's front-running style could clash with Valley Ofthe Kings if both go forward early
Trilby blew the start badly last time and cannot afford similar gate issues in a competitive handicap

races.paceDynamic: Miss Rainbow will lead from the outset with Keldeo and Filly's Last Lady providing early support in prominent positions. The majority of the field - One Of Our Own, White Umbrella, Paroda Diva, Fizzy Cristal, Moostar and Indy's Angel - will all need luck in running from hold-up positions. With just one confirmed front runner in Miss Rainbow, she should dictate a manageable gallop through the early stages. This race shape strongly favours the early-positioned horses who can avoid traffic problems in what will become a tactical affair.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Rainbow sets a steady tempo without pressure from Keldeo or Filly's Last Lady
scenarios.body: The race becomes tactical with Miss Rainbow controlling the fractions, allowing her stamina to tell in the final furlong while the hold-up horses struggle to make ground. The prominent runners get first run and maintain their positional advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Speed Duel
scenarios.trigger: If Keldeo or Filly's Last Lady challenge Miss Rainbow for the early lead
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and creates gaps for the better-handicapped hold-up horses to exploit in the final two furlongs. Fizzy Cristal and Moostar benefit from the stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace collapses completely and becomes crawling
scenarios.body: The race turns into a sprint from the 2f pole where the freshest finishers can unleash their turns of foot. One Of Our Own and Paroda Diva have the class to win from impossible positions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Nightmare
scenarios.trigger: If the field bunches up turning for home with multiple hard-luck stories
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery where positioning and luck matter more than ability, potentially allowing an outsider to slip through. Any horse that gets a clear run has a chance regardless of odds.

watchPoints.text: Miss Rainbow could steal the race if allowed an uncontested lead given her front-running style and William Pyle's claiming allowance
Keldeo may struggle with the extra furlong beyond her preferred 5f trip despite her course form
The large group of hold-up horses could encounter serious traffic problems in the straight with limited early pace
Fizzy Cristal represents the main threat from the rear given her recent AW form and manageable weight rise
One Of Our Own's lengthy absence makes her vulnerable despite her excellent C&D record when fit
